paragraphs: Mobile & AI Engineer with 6+ years building apps, specialized in fintech and digital banking. Flutter is my base, and I also work with React Native, Swift, Kotlin and React.
I am currently on the Mobile Core team at ueno bank, building the technical foundation used by 40+ microapps. I focus on modular architecture, scalability and production releases.
I started in 2019 as an IT Trainee and became a mobile team lead in 2022. I am studying Computer Engineering at USAL and building my own products under Byto Apps.
